mobbin:6ec8698e-d2a3-4d6f-a711-3e4025e51.summary: Admin opens the company home with admin quick actions and approval widgets, then lands on the employee portal home with personal first-time setup and self-service labels.
steal: The profile menu shows name and role ('Sam Lee, Admin') and an explicit 'Employee portal' link to switch views without logging out (screen 1).
Admin-only quick-action buttons sit under the greeting (Add employee, Create post, New onboarding), plus an approvals widget ('1 unhandled' time-off request) (screen 1).
The employee home shows a left icon sidebar, personal labels, and a full-width 'Go to your onboarding' banner (screen 2).
Empty widget areas keep structure ('You have no assigned tasks', 'No upcoming birthdays this week') instead of collapsing the layout (screen 1).
avoid: The role switch is a one-way 'Employee portal' jump. The employee screen does not show the current role label or an obvious path back to Admin (screens 1-2).
mobbin:6ec8698e-d2a3-4d6f-a711-3e4025e51.fit: Dashboard: replaces the deferred role-specific widget layer. The admin home keeps User management and Courses quick actions and approval queues on the dashboard. The employee home hands off first-time setup and profile tasks to Courses and User management and keeps personal recording and feedback entry light.
